# Official conversion reference

`prusaslicer.bgcode` and `prusaslicer.gcode` are the `mini_cube_ps2.8.1.bgcode`
and `mini_cube_ps2.8.1_ref.gcode` fixtures from
[Prusa libbgcode](https://github.com/prusa3d/libbgcode/tree/d4da9073616d70a43c151e8c1d7fbff879d2e08a/tests/data),
revision `d4da9073616d70a43c151e8c1d7fbff879d2e08a`.
The upstream GNU AGPL license is included. These are unchanged reference bytes.
